title: Normal Chip H3 Control
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: After isolation, resuspend 1 × 10⁶ cells in 1 % formaldehyde and incubate for 14 min; then add glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM and incubate an additional 1 min to quench fixation.

steps.title: Wash and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma Aldrich, 303410); then harvest the cells by scraping from the plates.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei with Covaris
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a Covaris tube and run the Covaris E220 for 4.5 min at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 % and 200 cycles/burst to isolate nuclei.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate chromatin
steps.instruction: For each sample, add 2 µg of the appropriate antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, 88802) to an equal amount of chromatin; incubate under the conditions described in Arrigoni 2018 (no barcode ligation or pooling).

steps.title: Quantify chromatin and DNA
steps.instruction: Measure chromatin concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific); then quantify the immunoprecipitated DNA with a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific) before library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct libraries using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England BioLab, E7645S) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate library size distribution and concentration with an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq platform using 150 bp paired‑end reads.
